---
title: "Sentiment Analysis using the NRC Lexicon: Finn the Wolfhound"
output: html_document
---




```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)


load(here("data/finn_clean.rda"))
```
### Use this as a starter file for sentiment analysis.  You should try each of the three lexicons. 
### It may make sense to copy this file and use one file per lexicon.

##decided to only explore nrc lexicon but add a word cloud first.

```{r}
install.packages("wordcloud")
library(wordcloud)
library(RColorBrewer) 

# Create a word cloud of the top 100 most frequent words in the book
finn_clean |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |>
  with(wordcloud(words = word, freq = n, 
                 max.words = 100, 
                 random.order = FALSE, 
                 colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")))
```
### im assining values to each word 

```{r}
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

nrc |> inner_join(finn_clean, by = "word", multiple = "all",
                  relationship = "many-to-many") -> fw_nrc
```
```{r}
fw_nrc |> 
  group_by(sentiment) |> 
  summarize(number = n()) |> 
  arrange(desc(number))
``` 

###from the word sentiment it looks to me that it is a neutralbook with fear being a top word. 
```{r}
fw_nrc |> 
  filter(sentiment == "fear") |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |> 
  head(20) |> 
  kable(caption = "Top 20 'FEAR' words in Finn the Wolfhound")
```
### looking at the words it does help pain a picture of the book but i will also looko at the trusting words
```{r}
fw_nrc |> 
  filter(sentiment =="trust") |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |> 
  head(20) |> 
  kable(caption = "Top 20 'Trust' words in Finn the Wolfhound")
```
#####I can see that there ia relatiship of high trust with mother and professor 

#### Create a bar chart of the overall emotional tone and getting vizulizations for a story 
```{r}
fw_nrc |> 
  group_by(sentiment) |> 
  summarize(number = n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sentiment, number), y = number, fill = sentiment)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Overall Sentiment Distribution in Finn the Wolfhound",
       x = "Sentiment", y = "Number of Words") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Plot the top 15 words driving the "Fear" sentiment
fw_nrc |> 
  filter(sentiment == "fear") |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |> 
  head(15) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(word, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 'Fear' Words in Finn the Wolfhound",
       x = "Word", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
### defenily found some insight that i liked. I noticed that fear words are when the dog is in the wild or woods. It could be a time when he is with the master but to futher show this i will be using clustering to see if there is a timeline. does the author give more fear and trust in certain chapters? is the fear more apperent when the dog is by hilslef , "hunting" . these match perfectly with 2002 to claim and my hypothsis.
